question: In a certain code language, ‘ALPHA’ is written as ‘MBPBI’ and 'GAMMA' is written as 'BHMBN'. How will ‘LASER’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

The logic followed here is:​

‘ALPHA’ is written as ‘MBPBI’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aae7f921b34936d2cb35c11bf55c929f203db24f87858fb6b3b9e1fe4d683142.png] 

And,

'GAMMA' is written as 'BHMBN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6eadbdb6851b54e80cc9c41b2806839ceb511a2799818d0c9cefd2a6d130e9a4.png] 

Similarly,

‘LASER’ will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2453062ccb5304157de944efbf811ff9d8e98cdc4e3b23632b7ea2ab9a7a94a.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
